intro:
Stack blocks to reach the sky!
Master real physics as towering structures sway!
Use crazy powers, cause epic crashes, and outplay your friends!
description:
BLOCKY POWERS is a fast-paced physics-based party game where every block matters! Grab a controller, challenge a friend, and build the tallest tower before everything comes crashing down.

Real Physics & Powerful Winds

Forget predictable block stacking. Every piece has real weight and balance, making each tower sway under dynamic physics. Powerful gusts of wind can strike at any moment, turning even the strongest structures into a challenge.

Sabotage Your Opponent

Building is only half the battle. Drop extra blocks directly onto your rival's tower to throw off their balance and ruin carefully planned structures.

Send awkward or heavy blocks
Disrupt your opponent's tower
Strike at the perfect moment to trigger a collapse

Perfect timing can change the outcome of every match.

2-Player Local Multiplayer

Plug in a second controller and enjoy instant head-to-head battles on the same screen.

Fast local multiplayer action
Customize wind strength and block speed
Perfect for parties, families, and friendly rivalries
Game Modes

Race Mode

Build to the target height before your opponent. Speed is important, but poor balance can bring everything down.

Survival Mode

Protect your limited lives by stacking carefully. Survive the wind, avoid losing blocks, and withstand your opponent's sabotage.

Features
Real-time physics-based block stacking
Direct block sabotage mechanics
Dynamic wind effects
Local 2-player multiplayer
Race and Survival game modes

Master real physics, outsmart the wind, sabotage your rival, and build your way to victory in Blocky Powers!
